title: feat(cli,plugin-audit): os migrate audit-mail-bodies masks the mail bodies that pre-#24688 audit and activity copies still hold in clear
body:
Closes #24693
Clause-②: yes

Residual R2 of the contract review of PR #24688. Before #24688 the audit writer copied `sys_email` / `sys_identity_email` rows into `sys_audit_log` and `sys_activity` with `body_text` / `body_html` in clear. Those bodies carry reset, verification, magic-link and invitation links. #24688 masks new copies only. This PR adds the one-time, idempotent cleanup for the copies written before it.

## Measured first: its own `os migrate` command, not a ceremony step

- **Order-independent.** The cleanup masks every copy of BOTH mail logs, as the writer does, so it needs no identity selector. Before the ceremony it masks the `sys_email` copies. After it, the activity copies that #24681's step 5b re-points to `sys_identity_email` are masked the same way, and `sys_audit_log` keeps the object name it was written under either way (#24681 does not rewrite the ledger).
- **Reach.** The residual exists on every database a pre-#24688 writer wrote to. A ceremony step reaches only databases that take the ceremony, and once each. A command also backports to a release line that has no ceremony.
- **Precedent.** `os migrate audit-metadata-bodies` is the same family of fix as its own command: dry run by default, no `sys_migration` flag.
- So no ceremony file is touched. File overlap with PR #24681 is zero.

Measured on the 18.0 upgrade-harness fixture (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-harness/fixture-18.0/`, base `d1173825b`): 2 `sys_audit_log` rows and 2 `sys_activity` rows (create sides) hold a clear mail body. Counts only; no value was printed.

## What changed

- **`@objectstack/plugin-audit`**
  - `mail-log-body-mask.ts`: `maskMailLogBodyCopy`, the one mask. A set body becomes `SECRET_MASK`, an unset one stays `null`, and no column is invented. `ledgerView` in `audit-writers.ts` now calls it instead of its inline loop, so the writer and the cleanup share one helper. The object names and body columns are still #24688's `MAIL_LOG_OBJECTS` / `MAIL_LOG_BODY_FIELDS` / `isMailLogObject`, and the mask value is still `SECRET_MASK`; none is re-spelled.
  - `mail-log-body-migration.ts`:
    - two pure planners, `planMailLogBodyAuditRowPatch` (for `new_value` / `old_value`) and `planMailLogBodyActivityRowPatch` (for both halves of `metadata`, keeping the pair's other keys);
    - a runner, `migrateMailLogBodyCopies`, that keyset-pages both tables by `id` (500 rows a page) with `object_name $in MAIL_LOG_OBJECTS` and writes only the copy column;
    - the write runs as the platform under `preserveAudit` with the row's stored `updated_at`, the shape `comment-parent-pair-backfill.ts` takes, so no other column of the row moves;
    - the report is counts only (per table: scanned, rewritten; plus failures), and an unread table counts as a failure, never as clean.
- **`@objectstack/cli`**: `os migrate audit-mail-bodies` takes `audit-metadata-bodies`'s flags one for one (`--database-url`, `--apply`, `--yes`, `--force`, `--json`), its read-only dry-run boot, and its `absentTableReads` view. It is enrolled in the one-shot family table, the `--json` stdout-purity family and the absent-database roster (with control rows).
- Docs: the `cli.mdx` data-migration table and a section. The platform checklist item `cli.migrate-plan-apply-json` goes to revision 6 (variant added, 18 → 19 subcommands). The tenant-audit census was regenerated (`--write`) for the runner's one new write call site, and the census page's hand-written figures were moved to match (230 → 231, 74 → 75, 129 → 130).
- Changeset `24693-audit-mail-bodies.md`: `minor` for plugin-audit and cli, with `Clause-②: yes` as measured: a new operator command and new exports, and no accept set narrowed for an author.

## Pins

- `plugin-audit/src/mail-log-body-migration.test.ts` (13): the mask, both planners and the paged runner, over 18.0-shaped rows on all four snapshot sides. It covers dry run, apply leaving 0 clear copies, non-body columns byte-identical, other objects untouched, a re-run that is a no-op, bounded pages, a failed read counted, the `preserveAudit` context, and no log line naming a body.
- `qa/dogfood/test/audit-mail-bodies.dogfood.test.ts` (4) runs the real `os` binary over a fresh copy of the **18.0 fixture**:
  - 0: the fixture holds clear copies on both tables;
  - 1: the dry run counts them, and every audit/activity row is byte-identical afterwards;
  - 2: `--apply` leaves **0** clear copies. A rewritten row differs only in its copy column, and there only in the body keys, which now read the mask. Every other column (`updated_at` included) and every other row is byte-identical;
  - 3: a re-run masks nothing and changes no byte.
  - It declares `test-budget: 20` (measured 12.84 s locally).
- **Reverse verification** (ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; the fix was committed first). The rewrite's mask call was made a no-op, plugin-audit rebuilt, and the dist preflight showed the marker live:
  - unit: **7 failed / 13**;
  - dogfood: **2 failed / 4** (the dry-run count, and 0-clear after apply).
  - Restored to `blob == HEAD`, rebuilt, `--absent` preflight clean, tree clean; then 13/13 and 4/4 green again.

## Proof (18.x line)

- **R1**: fresh boot (`pnpm dev -- --fresh` on a random port): health 200, seeded-admin sign-in 200, 0 error lines, server stopped.
- **R2**: `upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts` passes, together with `identity-mail-read-gate` and the new pin: 3 files, 32 passed.
- **R3**: the harness's case 4 (the v17-trait copy is refused at boot), inside the R2 run.
- **R4**: `cli serve-walled-posture-refusal.test.ts`: 5 passed.

## Tests and gates

- `@objectstack/plugin-audit`: 59 files, 953 passed. typecheck exit 0 (plugin-audit, cli, dogfood).
- `@objectstack/cli` unit tier: 314 files, 4,643 passed.
- Integration, on the touched files (`data-commands.absent-database`, `schema-migrate.one-shot-family`): 2 files, 151 passed.
- `json-stdout-purity.e2e` (nightly tier): 64 of 65 pass, including the family-equality case with the new member. The 1 red is `os migrate organization-ownership --json`'s stderr-diagnostics case, a command this diff does not touch. NOT MEASURED on base.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 104 commands (105 after the census files joined the diff). Exit codes were captured before any pipe:
  - 98 exited 0 on the first sweep.
  - Fixed and re-run at exit 0: `check-tenant-audit-census` and its `--self-test` (the new write call site), and `check:objectql-double-limit` (the test double now applies the caller's bound by presence).
  - NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone), spec `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (both need a full-workspace build). CI runs them.
  - `check:merge-driver` (new in the second derivation) exit 0. `--ran` reconciled 105 of 105.
- `check-governed-merges --branch`: 0 of 13 paths on the register, not governed. 1,130 changed lines.
- **After merging `main` (head `6da0543a`, clean merge; `main` brought one plugin-audit change, `sys-audit-log.object.ts`):** rebuilt the dogfood closure. plugin-audit: 59 files, 959 passed. Dogfood (`audit-mail-bodies`, `upgrade-18x-harness`, `identity-mail-read-gate`): 3 files, 32 passed. `check-tenant-audit-census`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The upgrade-harness fixture is a dump of TABLES only, so it carries no `sys_activity` view (the rotation's read view over its shards). Any read-only boot over it, which creates nothing, reads no activity rows. The new pin puts the view back as the server left it, and says so. A real 18.0 database carries the view, so this is fixture fidelity, not a command defect. It affects any read-only command test on that fixture.
- A platform administrator, the one reader the body field is served to, no longer reads a pre-upgrade mail body in the audit trail once the command has run. The mail log row keeps its body behind its gate. The changeset says so.
- The option-B precondition is recorded on #24693, in the os-dev report.
- Not touched: `docs/adr/**`, `content/docs/releases/`, every ceremony file of #24681.
